blocks.h2: What Does an Ejector Pump Do?
blocks.body: A toilet, shower or sink below the level of the sewer line can't drain by gravity. Its wastewater flows into a sealed basin in the floor, and an ejector pump lifts it up and into the main line. A float turns the pump on, and a check valve keeps the water from falling back. When any of those parts fails, the basin fills and backs up into the basement.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber working on the discharge pipe of a basement sump pump

blocks.h2: Signs Your Ejector Pump Is Failing

tiles.body: The water in the basin is higher than it should be.
A worn lid seal or a vent problem.
A stuck float or a failed check valve.

blocks.intro: Basement bathrooms are common in Mokena homes built in the 1990s and 2000s, and so are ejector pumps.

items.body: A pump installed when the basement was finished 20 years ago is due for replacement.
Even "flushable" wipes wrap around the impeller and jam it.
If the alarm is dead, the first warning is water on the floor. We test it on every visit.

items.h3: Part of a Flood Control Setup
items.body: In some homes, the ejector pit is the heart of an [overhead sewer system](/mokena/overhead-sewer-systems).
Some Mokena basements have a laundry tub or washer draining to the ejector basin. Lint is hard on pumps, so a lint trap on the washer hose helps.

blocks.h2: Ejector Pump Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: How long does an ejector pump last?
items.answer: Often around 7 to 10 years, depending on use and what goes down the drains.

items.q: Can I use the basement bathroom if the alarm is on?
items.preview: No. Stop using it until it's fixed.
items.answer: No. Stop using every drain that feeds the basin until we fix the pump, or it will overflow.

items.q: Why does my basement bathroom smell like sewer?
items.preview: Usually the basin lid seal or the vent.
items.answer: Usually a worn lid seal, a loose vent connection or a dry floor drain trap nearby. We check all three.

items.q: Can you add an ejector pump for a new basement bathroom?
items.answer: Yes. We install the sealed basin, a pump sized for the fixtures and the venting it needs.

items.q: How much does ejector pump replacement cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the pump and the basin. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, the basin condition and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
